## Goal

One or two sentences: what is true when this epic is done?

## Scope

- In scope item

## Non-goals

- Out of scope item

## Stories

- [ ] Story issue link or number

## ADR

Link or path of the decision record, or "none needed".

## Success measure

How will we know it worked? Name a number or an observable result.
